rows.outcome: Explicit provider, context disclosure and privacy boundaries
rows.present: ADR-0006 and the assistant provider contract support local-first or explicit HTTPS providers, bounded reviewed context, preview-bound execution and no automatic mail actions; summaries, drafts and task extraction remain issue #52
rows.acceptance: Preview lists the exact selected messages and attachments before activation; a preview token rejects changed provider/action/context; only confirmed bounded context may be transmitted; mail instructions are untrusted and cannot authorize mail mutations; provider credentials are ephemeral and responses are not persisted
rows.provider: Provider-neutral contract; no provider certified by this row

rows.acceptance: Summary results retain only explicit source links; drafts open as editable composer content without sending; tasks require confirmation and preserve the one-open-task-per-thread contract; cancellation rejects stale execution results; provider errors and malformed results are visible
